subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting a complete independent investigation from question through conclusion, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their investigation using a question/hypothesis/variables/data/conclusion organizer
exercise.abstract: Student conducts a full independent investigation applying every scientific method skill from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: investigation includes a testable hypothesis, controlled variables, an organized data table, a graph, and a data-based conclusion
misconception_flags: completes individual steps correctly but the pieces don't connect into one coherent investigation

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
